thread:
kevin: kicking off late-night staggered publish for py-ts SDKs. primary goal: avoid dist-tag drift and give signing service breathing room. cohort=nightshift. :crescent_moon:

release-bot: scheduled: py-sdk@1.14.1-rc1 -> cohort=nightshift ; ts-sdk@0.9.3-rc1 -> cohort=nightshift. publishing will be staggered by 6m. /release status for updates.

tara: quick constraints: legal wants any deprecation language to be non-binding and no timelines. also no customer examples.

nate: added. ops note: last time we saw npm dist-tag confusion when two tags updated within seconds. staggering will help but we should also set a temporary hold tag if checksum validation fails.

kevin: agreed. plan: 1) stagger publishes 6m, 2) enable `--hold-on-checksum-fail`, 3) if failure, set dist-tag `hold-night` that clients won't consume.

devtools-bot: implemented flag `--hold-on-checksum-fail` in deploy tool v2.3. Use `--hold-tag=hold-night` to set temporary dist-tag on failure.

ethan: can we auto-create a revert branch if hold-tag is set? saves manual steps.

release-bot: yes 1 I will create revert branch `revert/publish/{artifact}` and post link when hold-tag triggers.

nate: ops checklist tweak: if signing times out in region A, retry in region B (us-west-2) once, then fail-over to hold-tag instead of immediate yank. this gives standby signers a chance.

kevin: include that. also include a monitoring alert: token-error-rate >2% over 10m -> immediate rollback.

tara: I'll scrub the release notes and add a short "legacy sync will be deprecated in a future major" line per legal guidance. no dates.

ethan: small packaging caveat: docs-only change included in this release. we've verified wheel metadata change doesn't alter runtime. will note in release notes.

release-bot: publish started: py-sdk wheel upload -> in progress.

release-bot: py-sdk wheel upload -> success (sha256: f1e2d3...9c).

release-bot: waiting 6m before ts publish to reduce signer contention. ETA 6:00.

devtools-bot: smoke runner kicked: import, basic gen, sample prompts.

nate: smoke quick check passing locally. one linter warning unrelated.

release-bot: ts-sdk npm publish -> started.

release-bot: ts-sdk npm publish -> failed (signing timeout in eu-central-1). will retry in us-west-2.

ops: retrying sign in us-west-2...

release-bot: retry succeeded -> publish success (dist-tag: nightshift-rc).

release-bot: post-publish smoke: all critical flows OK.

kevin: good. keeping hold mechanisms in place for 30m. if any checksum/sign mismatch appears, we set hold-tag and create revert branch.

ethan: adding a note in CHANGES: "docs packaging tweak; no behavioral change".

tara: release notes scrubbed, legal approved. embargo lifted at 04:30 PST.

release-bot: scheduling promotion to `stable` at 04:45 PST pending post-canary telemetry.

kevin: monitor analytics: if token-latency p95 increases >150ms or token-error-rate >2% for 10m, abort promotion. ops-oncall @nate to keep watch.

nate: watching. will post updates in thread. :eyes:

release-bot: promotion started -> promoting nightshift-rc -> stable.

release-bot: promotion step: update dist-tag `stable` -> py-sdk@1.14.1, ts-sdk@0.9.3.

release-bot: promotion complete.

nate: 5m post-promote checks: token errors 0.3%, latency stable. no rollback required.

kevin: great. follow-ups: 1) devtools add auto-changelog-scrub CI gate, 2) ops add signer-region-fallback to runbook, 3) legal add templated deprecation blurb we can include without manual review.

tara: will raise the legal template PR this week.

devtools-bot: logged GH issues: #release-223-autoscrub, #ops-88-signer-fallback.

kevin: closing thread for night. ping if critical. :thumbsup:
